records.claim: Some studies suggest a higher chance of preterm delivery (birth before week 37) when venlafaxine is used in pregnancy, while other studies do not. However, research has also shown that when depression is left untreated during pregnancy, there could be an increased chance of pregnancy complications. This makes it hard to know if it is the medication, untreated or poorly treated depression, or other factors that can increase the chance of these problems. For more information, please see our fact sheet on depression at https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/depression-pregnancy/.
records.source_section: Does taking venlafaxine in pregnancy increase the chance of other pregnancy-related problems?
